name: spring-boot-microservices
description: Design, scaffold, and review modern Java Spring Boot microservices (Spring Boot 4.x / Spring Framework 7 / Java 25 LTS, Maven + Gradle). Full modern stack: REST/Problem Details, JPA/persistence, Spring Security OAuth2, Spring Cloud (Gateway/Config/discovery), Resilience4j, Kafka + transactional outbox, Micrometer + OpenTelemetry, Testcontainers, and Kubernetes-native deployment. Three modes: design, scaffold, and review/audit.
